meta.footEn: Data snapshot: 2026-08-28 · Garmin fenix 8 via Freddy

en.c5d: computed from sleep, HRV, RHR, stress & recent load
en.rec: Short night, but the best-built one in a week. The score is 79 on 6h 27m, lights out 23:39 and awake 06:26. Take the two nights together and the story is a clean rebound: Wednesday evening was the weakest night of the seven — score 70, 41 minutes awake, RHR up at 57 — and last night undid almost all of it. Deep sleep is the headline. 1h 44m, 27% of the night, nearly double Wednesday's 55 minutes and the most since Friday 21's 1h 59m. Deep has been the one number this board kept flagging: 33 minutes on Tuesday evening, 55 on Wednesday, now 104. That is the recovery machinery working, and it came the night after the biggest single lifting session of the window. The trade-off sits in REM. 63 minutes, 16% of the night, is the thinnest REM slice of the seven and well under the 90–96 you were logging earlier in the week. That is what a short night costs — REM is back-loaded, so the hours you cut come out of it first. Efficiency was 95%, with 20 minutes awake, and light sleep took 3h 40m. The autonomic picture is fully recovered. HRV came back to 39, three above Wednesday's 36 and exactly on the seven-night average. RHR dropped three beats to 54, straight back to baseline after Wednesday's 57. Overnight stress read 16, the lowest of the whole window, and Body Battery charged 58 — the best charge of the week. Readiness lands at 77, good, and it is a genuinely better 77 than the last two mornings because the underlying markers, not just the score, moved the right way. So the only complaint is length. 6h 27m is 35 minutes under the 7h 02m average and the second-shortest night on the board. Bedtime is drifting: 23:08, 23:34, 23:39 — three nights walking later while Wednesday's 07:32 wake was a one-off and you were back at 06:26 today. Monday's 22:20 is still the only night this week that bought eight hours. Pull lights out back to 22:45 tonight; with deep sleep and HRV already where you want them, length is the last thing left to fix.

hr.c5d: izračunato iz sna, HRV-a, RHR-a, stresa i opterećenja
hr.rec: Kratka noć, ali najbolje građena u tjednu. Ocjena je 79 uz 6h 27m, svjetlo u 23:39, buđenje u 06:26. Uzmeš li dvije noći zajedno, priča je čist oporavak: srijeda navečer bila je najslabija noć od sedam — ocjena 70, 41 minuta budnosti, RHR povišen na 57 — a sinoćnja je gotovo sve to poništila. Duboki san je glavna vijest. 1h 44m, 27% noći, gotovo dvostruko više od srijedinih 55 minuta i najviše od petka 21. i njegovih 1h 59m. Duboki san bio je onaj broj koji je ova ploča stalno isticala: 33 minute u utorak navečer, 55 u srijedu, sada 104. To je mehanizam oporavka koji radi, i došao je u noći nakon najvećeg pojedinačnog treninga dizanja u prozoru. Cijena je u REM-u. 63 minute, 16% noći, najtanji je REM udio od sedam noći i znatno ispod 90–96 koliko si bilježio ranije u tjednu. To je ono što kratka noć košta — REM dolazi pred kraj, pa se sati koje odrežeš prvo oduzimaju njemu. Učinkovitost je bila 95%, uz 20 minuta budnosti, a laki san uzeo je 3h 40m. Autonomna slika je potpuno oporavljena. HRV se vratio na 39, tri iznad srijedinih 36 i točno na sedmodnevnom prosjeku. RHR je pao za tri otkucaja na 54, ravno natrag na osnovicu nakon srijedinih 57. Noćni stres iznosio je 16, najniže u cijelom prozoru, a Body Battery napunio se 58 — najbolje punjenje u tjednu. Spremnost je 77, dobra, i to je stvarno bolja 77 nego zadnja dva jutra jer su se pomaknuli sami pokazatelji, a ne samo ocjena. Jedina zamjerka je dakle trajanje. 6h 27m je 35 minuta ispod prosjeka od 7h 02m i druga najkraća noć na ploči. Lijeganje klizi: 23:08, 23:34, 23:39 — tri noći koje hodaju sve kasnije, dok je srijedino buđenje u 07:32 bilo jednokratno, a danas si opet bio budan u 06:26. Ponedjeljkovih 22:20 i dalje je jedina noć ovog tjedna koja je kupila osam sati. Vrati gašenje svjetla na 22:45 večeras; kad su duboki san i HRV već tamo gdje ih želiš, trajanje je zadnje što treba popraviti.
